timeline.summary: On April 24, 2026, Five-Star Business Finance reported the lapse of 1,00,000 preferential warrants and forfeiture of ₹1.93 Cr upfront consideration.

On April 28, 2026, Five-Star Business Finance released its Q4FY26 investor presentation highlighting an 11% AUM growth and 98.1% collection efficiency.
Five-Star Business Finance Limited’s **Vigneshkumar SM** schedules physical investor/analyst meet with EQT Partners on **May 06, 2026**, per SEBI LODR.

Five-Star Business Finance Limited’s officials will hold a virtual investor/analyst meeting with Latent PMS on May 13, 2026, as per SEBI LODR.

Five-Star Business Finance Limited’s officials will meet HDFC Mutual Fund, Nippon Mutual Fund, Axis Max Life Insurance, and Kotak Mahindra Mutual Fund in Mumbai on May 19, 2026, via physical meetings (1:1).

Lakshmipathy Deenadayalan, Hema Deenadayalan, and Shritha Lakshmipathy declared no share encumbrances under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4) for FY2026, with nil pledged shares as of March 31, 2026.

watchlist.text: Structural growth was earlier talked of as 25%; analysts asked why guidance is now 18-20%.

watchlist.response: Management said the ECL framework for banks starts only from 1 April 2027 and it does not expect the 5% floor for NBFCs soon, but is being conservative on credit cost.

watchlist.response: Stronger collections lifted repayments; a policy change now gives top-ups to best customers instead of forcing full prepayment, which should help.
